From: Gregory Paulsen, Site Services Manager
Date: October 6
Subject: Parking arrangements during resurfacing
Resurfacing of Halton Yard will begin on October 20 and continue until December 15. The affected section will stay closed for the whole period, leaving 96 of the yard's staff spaces in use. The separate visitor parking area is not part of the work and keeps all of its spaces.
For these weeks, on-site permits will be issued only to employees whose duties require them to drive during the working day. Until now, permits have not been limited in this way, and 180 were issued for the current year. Staff who do not meet this test will not be assigned a yard space, whatever their role.
Employees who are not entitled to a yard permit may instead use the leased lot on Ludgate Street, an eight-minute walk away, which holds 60 cars and costs $18 a month. Two other nearby places are not part of this arrangement: the visitor parking area, which remains reserved for visitors, and the public garage on Lomax Street, where the company has no agreement for staff parking.
Permits for the yard are picked up from the security desk on level one. A new permit will not be released until the current one is handed back, and no employee may hold more than one permit at a time.
Employees who believe their duties qualify them for a yard permit must submit a written request to the Site Services office by October 17. Any questions may be directed to extension 2650.
GP
